_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Jugasti Golf (pukara k'artita) - Jugador {player_id}.
Objetivo: Ukax mä jach'a puntuacióni jark'äwita round. Ukax columnas compartidas mä jach'a valor, ukax sumadas 0.
K'artita Valores: A=1, 2-10=valor cara, J/Q=10, K=0

Acciones (usa exacto corchetes):
- '[draw]' - Roba deck
- '[take]' - Toma descarte
- '[swap X Y]' - Intercambia k'artita robada con posición X (fila) Y (columna)
- '[discard]' - Descarta k'artita robada

board.drew:
Janiw q'awaraki: {card}
Jichhuraki [swap X Y] utjiwa [discard]
board.took:
Janiw saxaraki: {card} walja apthapin
Jichhuraki [swap X Y] utjiwa (manaspani walja)

options.final_turns: Jichhuraki q'awaraki! Kamisax q'awaraki: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Jumax: [swap X Y] (janit tarjetanak jaqsuñ puqut apaqkasmati)

message.knocked: Jugador {pid} thuqhuña!  Mayni jugador mayni mara t'aqha.
message.final_round: Jugador {pid} {reason}! Mayni jugador mayni mara t'aqha.

invalid.wrong_action: Mayni uka ch'amanchawi: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], jan ukaxa [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Janiw mä carta apanukcasmati, jan ukasti turkakipañamawa.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Tienes k'artita robada. Debes [swap X Y] o [discard] uka.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Mä carta apanukuñatakejj mä tarjetaw munasi.
